*Why needed:* The org also holds Salesforce's QuantumBit demo catalogs (314 products). A separate Mindbody catalog keeps reps out of unrelated products, and categories mirror how Mindbody sells (spec section 3).

3. Every sellable product sits in exactly one category, except bundle-only products (MB-CAT-02).

*How it's built:* Standard Product Catalog Management; loader steps catalog and products. Classifications: Mindbody Subscription Tier, Branded App, Payments, Hardware, SMS Bundle.

*Spec reference:* CAT-01, PD-01

Description:
*User story:* As a sales rep, I want add-ons offered only inside a tier that allows them, so that I cannot build a quote Mindbody will not sell.

*Why needed:* Add-on rules depend on the tier: no AI Concierge add-on on Starter or Ultimate, Branded app only on Accelerate and Ultimate. Constraint-model disable rules are not applied in Browse Products in this release, so a rep could add an invalid add-on straight from the catalog.

*Acceptance criteria:*
1. AI Concierge add-on, Branded app and Branded app setup are not in any category.
2. They can be added only through a tier bundle's Add-ons group.
3. The 12 included features are also bundle-only.

*How it's built:* Product setting 'sold only with other products', no category; the bundle structure decides where each add-on appears.

*Spec reference:* CR-04, CR-05, CR-08

Description:
*User story:* As a sales rep, I want Starter, Accelerate and Ultimate with fixed prices per location per month, so that I can quote a studio in minutes.

*Why needed:* The tiers are Mindbody's core revenue. Each location buys one tier, so the unit is the location, and contract terms and billing options differ by tier (spec CAT-07).

*Acceptance criteria:*
1. Unit of measure Location; quantity = number of locations.
2. Starter bills Monthly or Annual only; Accelerate and Ultimate also Quarterly and Semi-Annual.
3. Contract term 12, 24 or 36 months (CR-13 blocks anything else).
4. Ultimate includes 1,000 texts per location per month.
5. Prices (USD/GBP/AUD/EUR): Starter 79/69/129/75; Accelerate 269/229/429/249; Ultimate 499/429/799/459.

*How it's built:* Product2 bundles with standard selling model options; custom fields Allowed Term Months and Allowed Billing Frequencies (no standard per-product list exists).

*Spec reference:* PD-01, PD-09, 3.1

*Build status (13 Nov 2026):* Done, priced and tested ($499 Ultimate -> $371.85 after volume, term and annual discounts)

*Acceptance criteria:*

*How it's built:* Custom fields on Product2 (no standard ERP key or sync status exists). Standard fields replaced earlier custom ones: Product Family, Quantity Unit of Measure, classification Mindbody Subscription Tier.

*Spec reference:* PD-14, NFR-07

*Build status (13 Nov 2026):* Fields done; the integration itself is phase 10
